title: spring.config.bus
description: The refresh bus reuses a NATS connection as its transport and carries only refresh signals, never configuration content. Every instance that shares a subject re-runs the application property refresh when a signal arrives.

subject.description: the NATS subject that refresh events are published to and subscribed from; all instances sharing it form one bus

watch-prefixes.description: comma-separated prefixes scoping which broadcasts this instance reacts to; empty refreshes on every event

origin.description: labels this instance as the publisher in a broadcast's RefreshEvent and producer span; defaults to the host name when empty

health.description: contribute a health.Indicator (readiness probes via starter-actuator)
